messages:
Zoe (People Ops): Quick heads up — Lumen (two reps) arriving tomorrow at 11:00am for a short demo. Can someone print two temp badges and leave them at the front desk? Also they sent a small samples box that's out for delivery today, tracking #ZX12345US. Please hold for me. @Front Desk
Front Desk: On it, Zoe. We'll have the badges printed and the table in Lobby A cleared. Do you want visitor stickers or lanyards? :white_check_mark:
Zoe (People Ops): Lanyards please. If the package comes before 5pm, can you ping me and put it on the left side of the counter?
Alex: I'll reserve the high-top in Lobby A for them at 10:45 — quieter than the hotdesks. Adding a note to the calendar invite.
Maya: Quick question — do they need network access or will they stay on guest Wi‑Fi?
Zoe (People Ops): Guest Wi‑Fi only. No VPN. Also note: they asked for a whiteboard and markers.
Sam: I can drop off markers and a small whiteboard eraser to Lobby A at 10:30.
Riley: If badge printer runs out of adhesive, there's an extra roll in the supply closet (keycode on the board).
deliveries-bot: Package update: Tracking ZX12345US — Out for delivery, estimated today by 4:20pm. 
Front Desk: Received the package at 3:58pm, left on the left side of the counter as requested. Zoe — I tagged you on the box. :package:
Zoe (People Ops): Got it, thank you! I'll grab it before the demo. Thanks everyone :heart:
Alex: :thumbsup: See you tomorrow.
Maya: Thanks — will meet the reps in Lobby A and walk them to Meeting Room B after a quick intro.
